verdict.rationale: Muse's own docs say users can link email and calendar, decide what the agent can see, and have it manage email on their behalf. Cloud drive is never named as a built-in connector; Muse says it can write custom connectors for services with APIs or CLIs, but no drive integration is shown. missing for 10: a documented cloud-drive connector, explicit evidence of searching connected sources to ground answers, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can connect my cloud drive, email, and calendar so the assistant can search and use them in answers

citations.quote: You decide what Muse can access. Link your email, calendar, Instagram, Facebook, health and fitness data, and finances.
Connect the apps you use daily, like email, calendar, and Instagram. You decide what your agent can see and what it can do.
It manages email, books dinners, tracks budgets, and finds deals, with your approval.
Muse can also write its own custom connectors for other services you care about if they have their own APIs or CLIs.
